description: This PHP source file defines the FilterTransformer class, which extends AbstractTransformer. It provides methods for transforming and retrieving information from a Model object related to filters within the Goteo project. The class handles getting project info, label text, description, status, associated users, role, and actions for editing or deleting the filter.

classes.name: FilterTransformer
classes.description: A class that extends AbstractTransformer to handle transforming filter models, providing methods for retrieving and manipulating filter data.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns a formatted string containing project name and a short review snippet.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns an icon and title for a given key, with special handling for the 'users' key.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Returns the project associated with the model.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the model.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description attribute of the model.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Returns filtered users associated with the model.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the role of the filter, formatted as a title string.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an array of actions (edit/delete URLs) based on user permissions and usage status.
